Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The experiment used APEX2 proximity-dependent biotinylation to label proteins near the inclusion membrane, followed by streptavidin affinity purification of these biotinylated proteins for MS analysis. While the proteins are associated with the inclusion membrane, this is the target of the proximity labeling rather than a traditional subcellular fractionation step (like differential centrifugation) prior to the affinity capture.
